europe_now.title: Tornado injures 40 in southern France
europe_now.summary: A tornado struck a village in southern France, injuring around 40 people and damaging homes. The event underscores the increasing frequency of extreme weather in the region.

sources.headline: Around 40 injured after tornado tears through village in the south of France

europe_now.title: EU warns of climate disaster costs without adaptation spending
europe_now.summary: The European Union has issued a warning that immediate investment in climate adaptation is necessary to prevent escalating disaster costs. This call underscores the systemic risks posed by climate change to European infrastructure and communities.

sources.headline: Europe must spend billions now or face mounting climate disaster costs, EU warns

top_stories.title: Poland signs €1.9bn NATO air-defence deal
top_stories.summary: Poland's defense company Mesko has secured a €1.9 billion contract to supply Piorun air-defence systems to four NATO member states. This agreement strengthens regional security capabilities within the alliance.

sources.headline: Poland’s Mesko signs €1.9bn deal to supply Piorun air-defence systems to four NATO countries

top_stories.title: Saudi-backed manga-themed park opens near Paris
top_stories.summary: A new manga-themed amusement park, backed by Saudi investment, is scheduled to open near Paris. The project reflects growing international economic collaboration in cultural and entertainment sectors.

sources.headline: New Saudi-backed manga-themed amusement park set to open near Paris

top_stories.title: UK drone factories face potential attacks, Kremlin adviser warns
top_stories.summary: A Kremlin adviser has warned that UK drone manufacturing facilities could be targeted by unidentified sources. This statement raises concerns about potential security risks to critical defense infrastructure.

sources.headline: UK drone factories may face attacks from 'unknown sources', says Kremlin adviser
